lessons.key: weak_test::a routing test must play every sound the engine can make impact tones whoosh rattle not only the first ones written
lessons.text: A routing test must play every sound the engine can make (impact, tones, whoosh, rattle), not only the first ones written.

lessons.key: weak_test::do not give engine parameters defaults that the real caller must pass required args let the build catch a dropped call
lessons.text: Do not give engine parameters defaults that the real caller must pass; required args let the build catch a dropped call.

lessons.key: ac_gap::rules wired inside react hooks or components roll launch motion step can roll predicate go in pure ts helpers with tests the hook only calls them
lessons.text: Rules wired inside React hooks or components (roll launch, motion step, can-roll predicate) go in pure .ts helpers with tests; the hook only calls them.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when two events can follow each other button roll then gesture cancel test the chain in the reducer not each half alone a cancel must not clear state it did not create
lessons.text: When two events can follow each other (button roll, then gesture cancel), test the chain in the reducer, not each half alone; a cancel must not clear state it did not create.

lessons.key: weak_test::gate on the same validity check the action uses parse not a proxy like a non empty string
lessons.text: Gate on the same validity check the action uses (parse), not a proxy like a non-empty string.

lessons.key: ac_gap::values a hook computes and forwards impulse throw action come out of the tested helper so the hook only passes them through
lessons.text: Values a hook computes and forwards (impulse, throw action) come out of the tested helper, so the hook only passes them through.

lessons.key: weak_test::walk lines quote the text the saved screenshot shows record them from the same run
lessons.text: Walk lines quote the text the saved screenshot shows; record them from the same run.

lessons.text: Physics rules (push velocity, surface per phase) go in pure helpers taking a body-like object, tested with a fake body; the component only wires them.
evidence: C17 C18 C19 / F6 F7 F10 F11 (physics)

lessons.key: spec_deviation::device motion axes are device fixed turn them by screen orientation angle and treat accelerationincludinggravity as having no usable direction
lessons.text: Device-motion axes are device-fixed: turn them by screen.orientation.angle, and treat accelerationIncludingGravity as having no usable direction.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::a push applied on every 60 hz sensor sample cancels itself on a back and forth shake let a moving body fly and push only slowed ones
lessons.text: A push applied on every ~60 Hz sensor sample cancels itself on a back-and-forth shake; let a moving body fly and push only slowed ones.
